old_caption: The video showcases a series of six heart-shaped foam pieces arranged in two rows on a plain white surface. Each heart is divided into two sections by a vertical cut, revealing a contrasting color on each side. The colors of the hearts include red, green, purple, pink, blue, and brown. A pair of scissors enters the frame from the right, moving downward to cut the brown heart. The scissors make contact with the brown heart, initiating a cutting motion. As the scissors continue their movement, they slice through the brown heart, creating a clean cut along its vertical division. The scissors are then removed from the frame, leaving the brown heart fully cut. The other hearts remain untouched throughout the sequence. The background remains static, focusing solely on the hearts and the scissors' action. There are no additional objects or characters present in the scene, and the camera maintains a consistent overhead shot, ensuring all details of the cutting process are clearly visible.

caption: The video showcases six teardrop-shaped foam pieces arranged in a two-by-three grid on a white surface. The top row contains red, green, and purple pieces, while the bottom row holds magenta, blue, and brown pieces. Each shape is already divided into two mirror-image halves separated by a narrow vertical gap. A black knife blade is the primary moving element interacting with these objects. Initially, the blade stands nearly vertically along the central cut line of the brown piece in the bottom right. The pointed tip rests near the top edge of the brown foam with minimal movement. The brown halves maintain their existing separation without visibly widening during this phase. Midway through, the blade withdraws to the right and exits the brown piece, leaving it resting uncut-looking. Shortly after, the blade re-enters from the top left corner and positions itself diagonally over the red piece. The tip contacts the left half of the red foam near its central gap, remaining with slight positional adjustments until the clip ends.
